creators.name: Ishita Rawat
creators.bio: Everyday styling with high-street and local labels: office looks, thrift finds and saree drapes that work on a commute. Runs a monthly series called One Kurta, Five Looks.
creators.quote: Good style should survive the local train.

creators.name: Sneha Kulkarni
creators.bio: Freelance model for catalogue and e-commerce shoots. Posts skincare routines for humid weather and honest reviews of products under ₹500.
creators.quote: If I wouldn't buy it again, I say so.

creators.name: Arjun Malhotra
creators.bio: Menswear on a budget: wedding-season outfits, kurta and jacket pairings, and simple grooming. Most of his audience is 20 to 30 and based in North India.

creators.name: Kavya Reddy
creators.bio: Short videos on city issues: lake clean-ups, waste segregation and how to file a civic complaint. Volunteers with a lake restoration group on weekends.
creators.quote: Small fixes, filmed properly, get other people started.

creators.name: Pooja Thakur
creators.bio: Gives talks on menstrual health in schools across Uttarakhand and answers the questions students ask most, in simple Hindi.

creators.name: Nikhil Joshi
creators.bio: Rental-friendly makeovers of small flats: lighting, storage and plants, with a cost breakdown in every video.

creators.name: Tanvi Rao
creators.bio: Posts process videos of her journals and hand lettering, and sells prints at weekend craft markets.

creators.name: Ritika Bose
creators.bio: Book reviews, Kolkata café guides and slow weekend vlogs. Hosts a small monthly online book club.

creators.title: Food & Travel
creators.subtitle: Food, travel and regional culture creators

creators.name: Zoya Khan
creators.bio: Home-style Awadhi recipes and food walks through old Lucknow. Every recipe video lists quantities for a family of four.

creators.name: Aditi Menon
creators.bio: Budget travel across South India by train and bus, with day-by-day itineraries and costs. Focuses on solo travel for women.
creators.quote: Sleeper class, window seat, full itinerary in the caption.

creators.title: Tech & Learning
creators.subtitle: Tech, personal finance and education creators

creators.name: Rohan Verma
creators.bio: Reviews phones and gadgets under ₹30,000 and explains settings in Hindi. Uses each phone for at least two weeks before posting a review.

creators.name: Neha Agarwal
creators.bio: Explains budgeting, SIPs and tax filing for first-time earners. Her videos are general education, not investment advice.
